question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city, 
           t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT cust_city,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019_q4,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020_q4
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE sales_2019_q4 > 0
      AND (sales_2020_q4 - sales_2019_q4) * 1.0 / sales_2019_q4 >= 0.20
),
product_overall_sales AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, SUM(s.amount_sold) as overall_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name, overall_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY overall_sales DESC) as tile
    FROM product_overall_sales
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT prod_id, prod_name, overall_sales
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE tile = 1
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
    SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
    GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_desc
)
SELECT tp.prod_name,
       ROUND(pqs_2019.product_sales * 1.0 / qt_2019.total_sales, 6) as share_2019_q4,
       ROUND(pqs_2020.product_sales * 1.0 / qt_2020.total_sales, 6) as share_2020_q4,
       ROUND(pqs_2020.product_sales * 1.0 / qt_2020.total_sales - pqs_2019.product_sales * 1.0 / qt_2019.total_sales, 6) as share_change
FROM top_20_percent tp
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2019 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2019.prod_id AND pqs_2019.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04'
JOIN product_quarter_sales pqs_2020 ON tp.prod_id = pqs_2020.prod_id AND pqs_2020.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04'
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2019 ON qt_2019.calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04'
JOIN quarter_totals qt_2020 ON qt_2020.calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04'
ORDER BY share_change DESC
